title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 5 章‧屍體污染（一）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
nâ-tat para-irithyeiti avi jãfnavô raonãm
â-tat merekhem uzvazaite haca bareshnavô gairinãm
avi jãfnavô raonãm upa-tãm kehrpem
franguharaiti ýãm iristahe mashyehe, â-tat
merekhem uzvazaite haca jãfnavô raonãm avi
bareshnavô gairinãm upa-tãm vanãm vazaite
xraozhdvanãmca varedvanãmca avi dim vañta
avi dim irita avi dim patita.
segments.en:
There dies a man in the depths of the vale: a bird takes flight
from the top of the mountain down into the depths of the vale,
and it feeds on the corpse of the dead man there: then, up it
flies from the depths of the vale to the top of the mountain:
it flies to some one of the trees there, of the hard-wooded or
the soft-wooded, and upon that tree it vomits and deposits dung.
segments.zh: 一個人死在谷底：一隻鳥從山頂飛下來到谷底，它在那死人的屍體上覓食：然後它從谷底飛起到山頂：它飛到那裡某棵樹上，是硬木的樹或軟木的樹，它在那棵樹上嘔吐並排放糞便。

segments.orig:
nâ-tat frashusaiti haca jãfnavô raonãm
avi bareshnavô gairinãm upa-tãm vanãm
aêiti ýãm hô merekhô âthre
aêsmãn ishaiti, avi dim janaiti avi dim thweresaiti
avi dim tâshti avi dim aiwi-raocayeiti âthrô
ahurahe mazdå puthrem kâ- hê asti citha.
segments.en:
Now, lo! here is a man coming up from the depths of the vale
to the top of the mountain; he comes to the tree whereon the bird
is sitting; from that tree he intends to take wood for the fire.
He fells the tree, he hews the tree, he splits it into logs, and
then he lights it in the fire, the son of Ahura Mazda. What is
the penalty he shall pay ?
segments.zh: 現在看啊！有一個人從谷底上來到山頂；他來到那隻鳥棲息的樹；從那棵樹他打算為火取木頭。他砍倒那棵樹，他鑿那棵樹，他把它裂成木段，然後他在火中點燃它，即阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子。他應當付什麼代價？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit spô-beretô
nôit vayô-beretô nôit vehrkô-beretô
nôit vâtô-beretô nôit maxshi-beretô
nasush narem nôit âstryeiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'There is no sin upon a man for any Nasu
that has been brought by dogs, by birds, by wolves, by winds,
or by flies.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『任何由狗、由鳥、由狼、由風或由蒼蠅帶來的納蘇，對一個人來說沒有罪。』

segments.orig:
ýezica aête nasâvô ýâ
spô-beretaca vayô-beretaca vehrkô-beretaca vâtô-beretaca
maxshi-beretaca nasush narem âstryeiñtîm ånghât
ishare-shtâitya mê vîspô anghush astvå
ishasem jit-ashem xraodat-urva peshô-tanush frêna
ånghãm nasunãm ýå paiti âya
zemâ irîrithare.
segments.en:
'For were there sin upon a man for any Nasu that might have
been brought by dogs, by
birds, by wolves, by winds, or by flies, how soon all
this material world of mine would be only one
Peshotanu, bent on the destruction of righteousness,
and whose soul will cry and wail! so
numberless are the beings that die upon the face
of the earth.'
segments.zh: '若有納蘇被狗、被鳥、被狼、被風或被蒼蠅帶來而降於人身上，為此有罪，我的整個物質世界將如何迅速變成唯有一個佩紹坦努，傾心於毀滅正義，其靈魂將哭喊與哀號！因為死亡於地面上的眾生是如此無數。'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum nâ-tat âpem hiñcaiti
avi ýavô-carânîm ana-tâ vaidhîm
ayå ana bitîm ana thritîm pasca tûirîm
nasâum ava-karesheñti spânem vâ raozhem
vâ vehrkem vâ kâ-hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Here is a man
watering a corn-field. The water streams down the field; it streams
again; it streams a third time; and the fourth time, a dog, a
fox, or a wolf carries some Nasu into the bed of the stream: what
is the penalty that the man shall pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！有一個人在灌溉穀田。水流過田野；它再次流過；它第三次流過；第四次，一條狗、一隻狐狸或一頭狼把某些納蘇帶到水流的河床裡：那個人應當付什麼代價？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit spô-beretô
nôit vayô-beretô nôit vehrkô-beretô
nôit vâtô-beretô nôit maxshi-beretô
nasush narem nôit âstryeiti.
segments.en: [Repeat st. 3.]
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『任何由狗、由鳥、由狼、由風或由蒼蠅帶來的納蘇，對一個人來說沒有罪。』

segments.orig:
ýezica aête nasâvô ýâ
spô-beretaca vayô-beretaca vehrkô-beretaca vâtô-beretaca
maxshi-beretaca nasush narem âstryeiñtîm ånghât
ishare-shtâitya mê vîspô anghush astvå
ishasem jit-ashem xraodat-urva peshô-tanush frêna
ånghãm nasunãm ýå paiti âya
zemâ irîrithare!
segments.en:
[Repeat st. 4.]
 
 IIa.
segments.zh: 『因為若有任何由狗、由鳥、由狼、由風或由蒼蠅帶來的納蘇對一個人來說有罪，那麼我這整個物質世界很快便會只是一個彼紹坦努，致力於破壞正義，其靈魂會哭喊和哀嚎！地面上死去的生物是如此之多。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum âfsh narem jaiñti
vâ, âat mraot ahurô mazdå, âfsh
narem nôit jaiñti astô vîdhôtush
dim bañdayeiti vayô dim bastem nayeiti âfsh
uzvazaiti âfsh nivazaiti âfsh paiti- raêcayeiti
vayô dim pascaêta franguhareñti,
athra adhât frajasaiti
baxta adhât nijasaiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy
One! Does water kill?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Water kills no man:
Asto-vidhotu binds him, and, thus bound, Vayu
carries him off; and the flood takes him up, the
flood takes him down, the flood throws him ashore;
then birds feed upon him. When he goes away, it
is by the will of Fate he goes.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！水殺死人嗎？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『水不殺死人：阿斯托─維德霍圖束縛他，如此被束縛，瓦尤帶他離去；洪水把他帶起，洪水把他帶下，洪水把他沖上岸；然後鳥在他身上覓食。當他離去時，他以命運之意而去。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum âtarsh narem jaiñti
vâ, âat mraot ahurô mazdå, âtarsh
narem nôit jaiñti astô vîdhôtush
dim bañdayeiti vayô dim bastem nayeiti âtarsh
hañdazhaiti asta ushtânemca,
athra adhât frajasaiti
baxta adhât nijasaiti!
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Does fire kill?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Fire kills no man: Asto-vidhotu binds him,
and, thus bound, Vayu carries him off; and the fire burns up life
and limb. When he goes away, it is by the will of Fate he goes.'
 
 III.
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！火焰會殺死人嗎？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「火焰不殺死任何人：阿斯托‧維德霍圖束縛他，這樣被束縛後，瓦尤將他帶走；火焰燒盡生命與四肢。當他去時，乃命運之意而去。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum frâ hama saciñte
atha aiwi-gâme kutha tê verezyãn aête
ýôi mazdayasna, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
nmâne nmâne vîsi vîsi thrâyô
kata uzdaithyãn aêtahe ýat iristahe.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If the summer
is past and the winter has come, what shall the worshippers of
Mazda do ? Ahura Mazda answered: 'In every house, in every borough,
they shall raise three rooms for the dead .'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若夏季已過，冬季已至，馬茲達的信徒應當如何行？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「每一所房屋，每一個城鎮，他們應當為死者起建三間屋室。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvañtô anghen aête
kata aêtahe ýat iristahe, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, ýat hê nôit eredvô ånghanem
vakhdhanem upa- janyât nôit frasha pâdhaêibya
nôit zastaêibya vîtarem, aêshô zî
asti dâityô kata aêtahe ýat iristahe.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How large shall
be those rooms for the dead? Ahura Mazda answered: 'Large enough
not to strike the skull of the man, if he should stand erect,
or his feet or his hands stretched out: such shall be, according
to the law, the rooms for the dead.
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那些為死者之屋室應當多大？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「應當寬敞至若人直身站立時其頭顱不相觸，或其足或其手臂伸展不相觸：按律法，死者之屋室應當如此。」

segments.orig:
aêtadha hê uzbaodhãm tanûm nidaithyãn
bixshaparem vâ thrixshaparem vâ mâzdrâjahîm
vâ vîspem â ahmât ýat frâ
vayô patãn frâ urvara uxshyãn nyåñcô
apa-tacin us vâtô zãm haêcayât.
segments.en:
'And they shall let the lifeless body lie
there, for two nights, or for three nights, or a
month long, until the birds begin to fly, the plants
to grow, the hidden floods to flow, and the
wind to dry up the earth.
segments.zh: 「且他們應當讓無生命的身體躺在那裡，二夜間，或三夜間，或一月長之久，直至鳥開始飛行，植物開始生長，隱沒的洪水開始流動，風開始乾燥大地。」

segments.orig:
âat ýat hîsh frâ vayô patãn
frâ urvara uxshyãn nyåñcô apa-tacin
us vâtô zãm haêcayât aêtadha
hê aête mazdayasna aêtem kehrpem hvare-daresîm
kerenaot.
segments.en:
'And as soon as the birds begin to fly, the plants to grow,
the hidden floods to flow, and the wind to dry up the earth, then
the worshippers of Mazda shall lay down the dead (on the Dakhma),
his eyes towards the sun.
segments.zh: 「且當鳥開始飛行，植物開始生長，隱沒的洪水開始流動，風開始乾燥大地之時，於是馬茲達的信徒應當把死人置放（於寂靜之塔上），其眼向著太陽。」

segments.orig:
ýezi nôit aête mazdayasna aêtem kehrpem
hvare-daresîm kerenavãn ýâre-drâjô
avavañtem ashavakhnyâi tãm cithãm daêsayô
vîspem â ahmât nasunãmca aiwi-varshtanãm
daxmanãmca aiwi-varshtanãm hixranãmca aiwi-varshtanãm
vayanãmca franguharetanãm!
segments.en:
'If the worshippers of Mazda have not, within a year, laid
down the dead (on the Dakhma), his eyes towards the sun, thou
shalt prescribe for that trespass the same penalty as for the
murder of one of the faithful; until the corpse has heen rained
on, until the Dakhma has heen rained on, until the unclean remains
have been rained on, until the birds have eaten up the corpse.'
segments.zh: 「若馬茲達的信徒未曾在一年之內把死人置放（於寂靜之塔上），其眼向著太陽，汝應當對於此過犯規定與謀殺忠信者之罪相同的刑罰；直至屍體已被雨淋，直至寂靜之塔已被雨淋，直至不潔遺骸已被雨淋，直至鳥已吞食屍體。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum âpem zazâhi tûm
ýô ahurô mazdå zrayanghat haca vouru-kashât
hathra vâtemca dunmãnca,
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Is it true at
thou, Ahura Mazda, seizest the waters from the sea Vouru-kasha
with the wind and the clouds?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達確實從海沃魯‧卡沙用風和雲奪取水域，此乃實否？

segments.orig:
avi nasûm vazâhi tûm ýô ahurô
mazdå upa daxmem vazâhi tûm ýô
ahurô mazdå upa hixrem vazâhi tûm ýô
ahurô mazdå upa astem frazayayâhi tûm
ýô ahurô mazdå anghaithîm frafrâvayâhi
tûm ýô ahurô mazdå tâ hathra
frafrâvayâhi avi zrayô pûitikem.
segments.en:
That thou, Ahura Mazda, takest them down to the corpses?
that thou, Ahura Mazda, takest them down to the Dakhmas? that
thou, Ahura Mazda, takest them down to the unclean remains? that
thou, Ahura Mazda, takest them down to the bones? and that then
thou, Ahura Mazda, makest them flow back unseen? that thou, Ahura
Mazda, makest them flow back to the sea Puitika?
segments.zh: 汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達將其帶下至屍體？汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達將其帶下至寂靜之塔？汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達將其帶下至不潔遺骸？汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達將其帶下至骨骼？且其後汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達令其無形地流回？汝阿胡拉‧馬茲達令其流回至海普伊提卡？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
aêvatha bâ zarathushtra
ýatha tûm erezvô vashanghe, âpem zazâmi
azem ýô ahurô mazdå zrayanghat haca vouru-kashât
hathra vâtemca dunmãnca,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is even so as thou hast said, O
righteous Zarathushtra! I, Ahura Mazda, seize the waters from
the sea Vouru-kasha with the wind and the clouds.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『正如你所說的那樣，義人查拉圖斯特拉啊！我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，用風和雲從沃魯‧卡沙海中取出水來。

segments.orig:
avi nasûm vazâmi azem ýô ahurô
mazdå upa daxmem vazâmi azem ýô ahurô
mazdå upa hixrem vazâmi azem ýô ahurô
mazdå upa astem frazayayâmi azem ýô ahurô
mazdå anghaithîm frafrâvayâmi azem ýô
ahurô mazdå tâ hathra frafrâvayâmi
avi zrayô pûitikem.
segments.en:
'I, Ahura Mazda, take them to the corpses; I, Ahura Mazda,
take them down to the Dakhmas; I, Ahura Mazda, take them down
to the unclean remains; I, Ahura Mazda, take them down to the
bones; then I, Ahura Mazda, make them flow back unseen; I, Ahura
Mazda, make them flow back to the sea Puitika.
segments.zh: 『我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，把它們帶到屍體那裡；我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，把它們帶下到寂靜之塔；我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，把它們帶下到不潔的遺骨；我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，把它們帶下到骨骼；然後我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，使它們無形地流回；我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，使它們流回到普伊提卡海。

segments.orig:
tê hishteñti khzhare-khzhareñtîsh
añtare aredhem zrayanghô, ýaozhdya taciñti
âpô zrayanghat haca pûitikât avi zrayô
vouru-kashem avi vanãm ýãm hvâpîm,
athra mê urvarå raodheñti vîspå
vîspô-saredhô satavaitinãm hazangravaitinãm
baêvare baêvaranãm,
segments.en:
'The waters stand there boiling, boiling up in the heart of
the sea Puitika, and, when cleansed there, they run back again
from the sea Puitika to the sea Vouru-kasha, towards the well-watered
tree, whereon grow the seeds of my plants of every kind by hundreds,
by thousands, by hundreds of thousands.
segments.zh: 『水在那裡沸騰著，在普伊提卡海的心臟中沸騰著，當在那裡被淨化後，它們再次從普伊提卡海流回到沃魯‧卡沙海，流向那株澆灌充分的樹，我的各種植物的種子在那上面生長，數以百計、數以千計、數以十萬計。

segments.orig:
tâ hathra vîvârayemi
azem ýô ahurô mazdå
hvarethemca naire ashaone
vâstremca gave hudhånghe, ýavô mê
mashyô hvarât vâstrem gave hudhånghe.
segments.en:
'Those plants, I, Ahura Mazda, rain
down upon the earth, to bring food to the faithful,
and fodder to the beneficent cow; to bring food to
my people that they may live on it, and fodder
to the beneficent cow.'
segments.zh: 『那些植物，我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，降雨到大地上，為信徒帶來食物，為有益的牛帶來飼草；為我的民族帶來食物使他們能以此生存，為有益的牛帶來飼草。』

segments.orig:
imat vanghô imat srayô
ýatha tûm erezvô vashanghe,
â-dim tâ vaca râmayat
ahurô mazdå ashava
ashavanem zarathushtrem, ýaozhdå mashyâi aipi-zãthem
vahishta, hâ ýaozhdå zarathushtra ýâ
daêna mâzdayasnish ýô hvãm anghvãm
ýaozhdâite humatâishca hûxtâishca
hvarshtâishca.
segments.en:
'This is the best, this is the fairest of all things, even
as thou hast said, O pure [Zarathushtra]!'
With these words the holy, Ahura Mazda rejoiced the holy Zarathushtra:
'Purity is for man, next to life, the greatest good, that purity,
O Zarathushtra, that is in the Religion of Mazda for him who cleanses
his own self with good thoughts, words, and deeds.'
segments.zh: 『這是最好的，這是萬物中最公正的，正如你所說的那樣，純淨的〔查拉圖斯特拉〕！』聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達用這些話使聖者查拉圖斯特拉歡喜：『潔淨對於人來說，次於生命之後，是最大的善，那潔淨，查拉圖斯特拉啊，那在馬茲達宗教中，是為了那用善念、善言和善行淨化自身的人的。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cû asti masyô vanghô
srayô aêtem dâtem ýim vîdôyûm
zarathushtri upairi anyâish sravâish masanaca vanghanaca
srayanaca.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! This Law, this
fiend-destroying Law of Zarathushtra, by what greatness, goodness,
and fairness is it great, good, and fair above all other utterances?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！這教法，這查拉圖斯特拉的滅魔教法，以什麼偉大、善良和公正而在所有其他言說之中偉大、善良和公正呢？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, mãnayen bâ
spitama zarathushtra aêtem dâtem ýim vîdôyûm
zarathushtri upairi anyâish sravâish masanaca vanghanaca
srayanaca ýatha zrayô vouru-kashem upairi anyå
âpô.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'As much above all other floods as is
the sea Vouru-kasha, so much above all other utterances in greatness,
goodness, and fairness is this Law, this fiend-destroying Law
of Zarathushtra.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『正如沃魯‧卡沙海在所有其他洪流之上，這教法，這查拉圖斯特拉的滅魔教法在偉大、善良和公正的事物上，就這樣在所有其他言說之上。

segments.orig:
mãnayen bâ spitama zarathushtra aêtem dâtem
ýim vîdôyûm zarathushtri upairi anyâish
sravâish masanaca vanghanaca srayanaca ýatha masyayå
âfsh kasyanghãm apãm avi- frâdavaiti,
mãnayen bâ spitama zarathushtra aêtem dâtem
ýim vîdôyûm zarathushtri upairi anyâish
sravâish masanaca vanghanaca srayanaca ýatha masyayå
vana kasyanghãm vanãm aiwi-verenvaiti.
segments.en:
'As much as a great stream flows swifter than a slender rivulet,
so much above all other utterances in greatness, goodness, and
fairness is this Law, this fiend-destroying Law of Zarathushtra.
'As high as the great tree stands above the small plants it overshadows,
so high above all other utterances in greatness, goodness, and
fairness is this Law, this fiend-destroying Law of Zarathushtra.
segments.zh: 『正如一條大河流得比一條細小的溪流更迅速，這教法，這查拉圖斯特拉的滅魔教法在偉大、善良和公正的事物上，就這樣在所有其他言說之上。大樹比它蔭下的小植物站得高，這教法，這查拉圖斯特拉的滅魔教法在偉大、善良和公正的事物上就這樣站在所有其他言說之上。

segments.orig:
mãnayen bâ spitama zarathushtra aêtem dâtem
ýim vîdôyûm zarathushtri upairi anyâish
sravâish masanaca vanghanaca srayanaca ýatha imãm
zãm âca pairica bvâva.
segments.en:
'As high as heaven is above the earth that it compasses around,
so high above all other utterances is this Law, this fiend-destroying
Law of Mazda.
'[Therefore], he will apply to the Ratu, he will apply to the
Sraosha-varez; whether for a draona-service
that should have been undertaken and has not been
undertaken; or for a draona
that should have been offered up and has not been offered up;
or for a draona that should have been entrusted and has not been
entrusted.
segments.zh:
「天空高於它所環繞的大地，此法高於所有其他的陳述，此滅魔鬼的馬茲達法。」
「因此他將呈訴於拉圖，他將呈訴於斯勞沙─瓦雷茲；無論是應當舉行卻未舉行的德拉奧納祭祀；或是應當獻上卻未獻上的德拉奧納；或是應當交付卻未交付的德拉奧納。」

segments.orig:
aoxtô ratush aoxtô sraoshâvarezô uzgereptât
paiti draonât nava uzgereptât dâtât paiti
draonât nava dâtât nisritât paiti draonât
nava nisritât xshayeite hê pascaêta aêsha
ýô ratush thrishum aêtahe cithå apangharshtêe,
ýezica hê anya akha shyaothna fravarshta paitita
hê citha, âat ýezi-shê anya akha shyaothna
nôit fravarshta paititem ahe narsh ýavaêca
ýavaêtâtaêca!
segments.en:
'The Ratu has power to remit him one-third of his penalty:
if he has committed any other evil deed, it is remitted by his
repentance; if he has committed no other evil deed, he is absolved
by his repentance for ever and ever.'
segments.zh: 「拉圖有權免除他三分之一的懲罰：若他已犯其他惡行，則由他的悔改而免除；若他未曾犯其他惡行，則由他的悔改而永遠獲得赦免。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô narô hâmô-gâtvô
nipaidhyeiñte hãm vâ paiti stairish hãm
vâ paiti barezish paitica hê anya dva vâ nara
anghen pañca vâ pañcâsatem vâ
satem vâ hãm nâirinãm âat aêshãm
narãm aêvô irithyât cvat añtare
nerêsh aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush axtica
pivatica âhitica frâshnaoiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If there be
a number of men resting in the same place, on the same carpet,
on the same pillows, be there two men near one another, or five,
or fifty, or a hundred, close by one another; and of those people
one happens to die; how many of them does the Druj Nasu envelope
with corruption, infection, and pollution?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若有眾多人等安息在同一處所，在同一地毯上，在同一枕上，有二人彼此靠近，或五人，或五十人，或百人緊靠一起；而這些人中有一人碰巧死去；德魯格‧納蘇有多少人被其腐敗、感染與污染所包裹？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýezi anghat
âthrava frâ-zî dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra
aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush ýezi aêvañdasô
frâshnaoiti dasemem paiti-raêthwayeiti, âat
ýezi anghat rathaêshtå frâ-zî dvãsaiti
spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush
ýezi dasemem frâshnaoiti nâumem paiti-raêthwayeiti,
âat ýezi anghat vâstryô fshuyãs
frâ- zî dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra aêsha
druxsh ýâ nasush ýezi nâumem frâshnaoiti
ashtemem paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'If the dead one be a priest, the Druj
Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama Zarathushtra! she goes as far as
the eleventh and defiles the ten.
'If the dead one be a warrior, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the tenth and defiles the nine.
'If the dead one be a husbandman, the Druj Nasu rushes forth,
O Spitama Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the ninth and defiles
the eight.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：'若死者是祭司，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第十一人並污染第十人。
'若死者是戰士，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第十人並污染第九人。
'若死者是農夫，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第九人並污染第八人。

segments.orig:
âat ýezi anghat spâ pasush-haurvô
frâ-zî dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra aêsha
druxsh ýâ nasush ýezi ashtemem frâshnaoiti
haptathem paiti-raêthwayeiti, âat ýezi anghat
spâ vish-haurvô frâ-zî dvãsaiti
spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush
ýezi haptathem frâshnaoiti xshtûm paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
'If it be a shepherd's dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O
Spitama Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the eighth and defiles
the seven.
'If it be a house-dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
she goes as far as the seventh and defiles the six.
segments.zh:
'若為牧羊犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第八人並污染第七人。
'若為家犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第七人並污染第六人。

segments.orig:
âat ýezi anghat spâ vohunazgô frâ-
zî dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh
ýâ nasush ýezi xshtûm frâshnaoiti
puxdhem paiti-raêthwayeiti, âat ýezi anghat
spâ taurunô frâ-zî dvãsaiti spitama
zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush ýezi
puxdhem frâshnaoiti tûirîm paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
'If it be a Vohunazga dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O
Spitama Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the sixth and defiles
the five.
'If it be a Tauruna dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the fifth and defiles the four.
segments.zh:
'若為沃胡納茲加犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第六人並污染第五人。
'若為陶魯納犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第五人並污染第四人。

segments.orig:
âat ýezi anghat spâ sukurenô frâ-
zî dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh
ýâ nasush ýezi tûirîm frâshnaoiti
thritîm paiti-raêthwayeiti, âat ýezi
anghat spâ jazhush frâ-zî dvãsaiti spitama
zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush ýezi
thritîm frâshnaoiti bitîm paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
'If it be a porcupine dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the fourth and defiles the three.
'If it be a Jazu dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
she goes as far as the third and defiles the two.
segments.zh:
'若為豪豬犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第四人並污染第三人。
'若為賈祖犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第三人並污染第二人。

segments.orig:
âat ýezi anghat spâ aiwizush frâ-zî
dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ
nasush ýezi bitîm frâshnaoiti paoirîm
paiti-raêthwayeiti, âat ýezi anghat spâ
vîzush frâ-zî dvãsaiti spitama zarathushtra
aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush ýezi paoirîm
frâshnaoiti paoirîm paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
'If it be an Aiwizu dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the second and defiles the next.
'If it be a Vizu dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
she goes as far as the next, she defiles the next.'
segments.zh:
'若為艾維祖犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至第二人並污染其次之人。
'若為維祖犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝飛而去，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她延伸至其次之人，污染其次之人。'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum âat ýezi anghat
spâ urupish cvat aêshô spâ ýô
urupish speñtahe mainyêush dâmanãm hãm-
raêthwayeiti cvat paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If it be a weasel,
how many of the creatures of the good spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP] does it directly
defile, how many does it indirectly defile?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若為鼬鼠，善靈〔斯彭塔‧曼紐〕的多少造物被其直接污染，多少被間接污染？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit aêsha
spâ ýô urupish speñtahe mainyêush
dâmanãm hãm-raêthwayeiti nôit
paiti-raêthwayeiti anyô ahmât ýô
janaiti fraca kushaiti â dim â-hishhaxti ýavaêca
ýavaêtâtaêca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered : 'A weasel does neither directly nor
indirectly defile any of the creatures of the good spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP], but
him who smites and kills it; to him the uncleanness clings for
ever and ever.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「黃鼠狼既不直接也不間接地污染善靈（斯彭塔‧曼紐）的任何生物，但它會污染那個打死它的人；對他，不潔便永遠永遠地依附。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum âat ýezi anghat
mairyô drvå bizañgrô avatha ashemaokhô
anashava cvat speñtahe mainyêush dâmanãm
hãm-raêthwayeiti cvat paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If the dead
one be such a wicked, two-footed ruffian, as an ungodly Ashemaogha,
how many of the creatures of the good spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP] does he directly
defile, how many does he indirectly defile?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果亡者是這樣一個邪惡的、兩腳的惡棍，如同一個無信仰的阿舍瑪歐格哈人，那麼他直接污染善靈（斯彭塔‧曼紐）的生物有多少，他間接污染的有多少？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýatha vazakhacit
vish-hushô tarô ýâre meretô, jvô
zî spitama zarathushtra mainyô drvå bizañgrô
avatha ashemaokhô anashava speñtahe mainyêush
dâmanãm hãm- raêthwayeiti jvô
paiti-raêthwayeiti,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'No more than a frog does whose venom
is dried up, and that has been dead more than a year. Whilst
alive, indeed, O Spitama Zarathushtra! such a wicked, two-legged
ruffian as an ungodly Ashemaogha, directly defiles the creatures
of the good spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP], and indirectly defiles them.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「不超過一隻毒液已乾枯、死亡已超過一年的青蛙。但當他活著時，啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！這樣一個邪惡的、兩腳的惡棍，如同一個無信仰的阿舍瑪歐格哈人，直接污染善靈（斯彭塔‧曼紐）的生物，也間接污染它們。

segments.orig:
jvô âpem jaiñti jvô âtrem frâvayeiti
jvô gãm varatãm azaite jvô narem ashavanem
frazâbaodhanghem snathem vîkeret- ushtânem jaiñti
nôit avatha meretô,
segments.en:
'Whilst alive he smites the water; whilst alive he blows
out the fire; whilst alive he carries off the cow; whilst alive
he smites the faithful man with a deadly blow, that parts the
soul from the body; not so will he do when dead.
segments.zh: 「當活著時他打水；當活著時他吹滅火；當活著時他掠奪牛；當活著時他以致命的打擊打擊信仰者，將靈魂從身體分離開；死後他將不會這樣做。

segments.orig:
jvô zî spitama zarathushtra mairyô drvå
bizañgrô avatha ashemaokhô anashava narem ashavanem
hanghush hvarethaheca vastraheca draoshca nimataheca ayangheca
apa-baraiti nôit avatha meretô!
segments.en:
'Whilst alive, indeed, O Spitama Zarathushtra! such a wicked,
two-legged ruffian as an ungodly Ashemaogha robs the faithful
man of the full possession of his food, of his clothing, of his
wood, of his bed, of his vessels; not so will
he do when dead.'
segments.zh: 「斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！當活著時，這樣一個邪惡的、兩足的惡棍，如同一個不信神的無阿沙者，搶劫信仰者完全擁有他的食物、他的衣服、他的木材、他的床、他的器皿；死後他將不會這樣做。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýôi nmânå
hãm-barâmahi ashâum ahura mazda ahmi anghvô
ýat astvaiñti âtremca baresmaca tashtaca haomaca
hâvanaca âat pascaêta ahe nmânahe spâ
vâ nâ vâ irithyât kutha tê verezyãn
aête ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When into our
houses here below we have brought the fire, the Baresma, the cups,
the Haoma, and the mortar, O holy Ahura Mazda! if it come to
pass that either a dog or a man dies there, what shall the worshippers
of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！當我們在下面把火、巴雷斯瑪、杯子、豪麻和臼帶進我們的房屋時，聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！如果碰巧在那裡狗或人死亡，馬茲達的信仰者應當做什麼？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, us haca aêibyô
nmânaêibyô barayen spitama zarathushtra âtremca
baresmaca tashtaca haomaca hâvanaca us haca iristem barayen
mãnayen ahe ýatha nâ dâityô dâityayâi
bairyeteca hvairyeteca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Out of the house, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
shall they take the fire, the Baresma, the cups, the Haoma, and
the mortar; they shall take the dead one out to the proper place
whereto, according to the law, corpses must be brought, to be
devoured there.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「出了房屋，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！他們應當帶出火、巴雷斯瑪、杯子、豪麻和臼；他們應當把死者帶到適當的地方，根據法律，屍體必須被帶到那裡被吞食。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kutha tê aête mazdayasna
aêtem âtrem aiti barãn ava aêtem nmânem
ýat aêshô nâ para-irithyât.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When shall they
bring back the fire into the house wherein the man has died?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！他們何時應將火帶回那男人已死去的家舍？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nava-xshaparem upa-mãnayen
aête ýôi mazdayasna aiwi-gâme âat
hama mâzdrâjahîm, pascaêta aête
mazdayasna aêtem âtrem aiti barãn ava aêtem
nmânem ýat aêshô nâ para-irithyât.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall wait for nine nights in winter,
for a month in summer, and then they shall bring back the fire
to the house wherein the man has died.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「在冬季他們應等待九夜，在夏季應等待一月，然後他們應將火帶回那男人已死去的家舍。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezica aête mazdayasna
aêtem âtrem aiti barãn ava aêtem nmânem
ýat aêshô nâ para- irithyât añtarât
naêmât nava-xshaparahe añtarât naêmât
mâzdrâjahîm kâ hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! And if they
shall bring back the fire to the house wherein the man iias died,
within the nine nights, or within the month, what penalty shall
they pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！而若他們在九夜之內、或在一月之內將火帶回那男人已死去的家舍，他們應付何罪罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti
peshô-tanuye duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall be Peshotanus: two hundred
stripes with the Aspahe-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他們應為塔納弗爾罪：以馬鞭鞭打二百次，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打二百次。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat ahmi nmâne
ýat mâzdayasnôish nâirika upas-puthrîm
jasât aêvô-mâhîm vâ bimâhîm
vâ thrimâhîm vâ cathru-mâhîm
vâ pañca-mâhîm vâ xshvash-mâhîm
vâ hapta-mâhîm vâ ashta-mâhîm
vâ nava-mâhîm vâ dasa- mâhîm
vâ aêtadha aêsha nâirika tadha aputhrîm
nijasât uzushtana kutha tê verezyãn aête
ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If in the house
of a worshipper of Mazda there be a woman with child, and if being
a month gone, or two, or three, or four, or five, or six, or seven,
or eight, or nine, or ten months gone, she bring forth a still-born
child, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若在馬茲達信徒之家有一懷孕之婦女，且已懷孕一月、或二月、或三月、或四月、或五月、或六月、或七月、或八月、或九月、或十月，她產下死胎，馬茲達信徒應作何事？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýat ahmi nmâne
ýat mâzdayasnôish fraêshtem ýaozhdâtô-zemôtememca
hushô-zemôtememca kambishtemca aête pathå
frayãn pasvasca staorâca âtremca ahurahe mazdå
baresmaca ashaya frastaretem naremca ýim ashavanem.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The place in that Mazdean house whereof
the ground is the cleanest and the driest, and the least passed through
by flocks and herds, by the fire of Ahura Mazda, by the consecrated
bundles of Baresma, and by the faithful;'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「在那馬茲達之家中，地面最潔淨、最乾燥，最少被牲畜踐踏，最少被阿胡拉‧馬茲達之火、聖別的巴爾什麻束、及信徒通過之處；」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat drâjô haca
âthrat cvat drâjô haca apat cvat drâjô
haca baresmen frastairyât cvat drâjô haca nerebyô
ashavabyô.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How far from
the fire? How far from the water? How tar fiom the consecrated
bundles of Baresma? How far from the faithful?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！距火多遠？距水多遠？距聖別的巴爾什麻束多遠？距信徒多遠？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrisata-gâim
haca âthrat thrisata-gâim haca apat thrisata- gâim
haca baresmen frastairyât thrigâim haca nerebyô
ashavabyô.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thirty paces from the fire; thirty
paces from the water; thirty paces from the consecrated bundles
of Baresma; three paces from the faithful;-
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「距火三十步；距水三十步；距聖別的巴爾什麻束三十步；距信徒三步；—」

segments.orig:
aêtadha hê aête mazdayasna ainghå
zemô pairi-daêzãn pairi-daêzayãn
hvarethaêibyô pascaêta âstayañta
aête ýôi mazdayasna vastraêibyô
pascaêta âstayañta aête ýôi
mazdayasna.
segments.en:
'On that place shall the worshippers of Mazda erect an enclosure,
and therein shall they establish her with food, therein shall
they establish her with clothes.'
segments.zh: 祆教信徒應在該處建立一個圍欄，並在其中用食物安置她，在其中用衣物安置她。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cish aêsha nâirika
paoirîm hvarethanãm hvarât.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What is the
food that the woman shall first take?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！該婦女首先應當服用何種食物？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, gêush maêsmana
âtryô-paiti-iristem thrish vâ shâmãn
ýat vâ xshvash ýat vâ nava aête
daxma upangharezaêta añtarât naêmât
barethrishva uruthwô-hva,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Gomez mixed with ashes, three draughts
of it, or six, or nine, to send down the Dakhma within her womb.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『混合灰燼的牛乳，三次飲用它，或六次，或九次，以將寂靜之塔送入她的子宮。

segments.orig:
âat pascaêta aipi-khzhaurvatãm aspayanãmca
payanghãm gâvayanãmca maêshinanãmca
buzyanãmca hãm-vaoirinãm us-vaoirinãm
gãmca hvâstem anâpem ýaomca ashem anâpem
madhuca anâpem.
segments.en:
'Afterwards she may drink boiling milk of mares, cows, sheep,
or goats, with pap or without pap; she may take cooked milk without
water, meal without water, and wine without water.'
segments.zh: 之後她可飲用沸騰的馬乳、牛乳、羊乳或山羊乳，有粥或無粥；她可服用不摻水的熟乳、不摻水的麥粉和不摻水的酒。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat drâjô upa-
mãnayen cvat drâjô upa-maitîm âste
hvareñti gãmca ýaomca madhuca.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How long shall she
remain so? How long shall she live thus on milk, meal, and wine?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！她應當如此維持多久？她應當如此靠乳、麥粉和酒生活多久？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrixshaparem upa-mãnayen
thrixshaparem upa-maitîm âste hvareñti gãmca
ýaomca madhuca, âat pasca thrixshaparât us
tanûm snayaêta us vastrât gêush maêsmana
apâca nava upa makhem paiti avatha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Three nights long shall she remain
so; three nights long shall she live thus on milk, meal, and wine.
Then, when three nights have passed, she shall wash her body,
she shall wash her clothes, with gomez and water, by the nine
holes, and thus shall she be clean.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『三夜長她應當如此維持；三夜長她應當如此靠乳、麥粉和酒生活。然後，當三夜過去後，她應當用牛乳和水在九個孔洞處洗淨她的身體，洗淨她的衣物，於是她便潔淨了。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat drâjô upa-
mãnayen cvat drâjô upa-maitîm âste
pasca thrixshaparât ýûtô gâtush
ýûtô hvaretha ýûtô vastra
ýûtô anyaêibyô mazdayasnaêibyô.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How long shall
she remain so? How long, after the three nights have gone, shall
she sit confined, and live separated from the rest of the worshippers
of Mazda, as to her seat, her food, and her clothing?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！她應當如此維持多久？在三夜過去後，她應當隔離而坐多久，並與其他祆教信徒分離生活，就座位、食物和衣物而言？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nava-xshaparem upa-mãnayen
nava-xshaparem upa-maitîm âste pasca thrixshaparât
ýûtô gâtush ýûtô hvaretha
ýûtô vastra ýûtô anyaêibyô
mazdayasnaêibyô, âat pasca nava-xshaparât
us tanûm snayaêta us vastrât gêush maêsmana
apâca paiti avatha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Nine nights long shall she remain so:
nine nights long, after the three nights have gone, shall she
sit confined, and live separated from the rest of the worshippers
of Mazda, as to her seat, her food, and her clothing. Then, when
the nine nights have gone, she shall wash her body, and cleanse
her clothes with gomez and water.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『九夜長她應當如此維持：九夜長，在三夜過去後，她應當隔離而坐，並與其他祆教信徒分離生活，就座位、食物和衣物而言。然後，當九夜過去後，她應當用牛乳和水洗淨她的身體，清潔她的衣物。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ vastra hãm-
ýûta pasca ýaozhdâiti frasnâiti
zaothre vâ hâvanâne vâ âtravaxshe
vâ fraberethre vâ âberete vâ âsnâthre
vâ raêthwishkare vâ sraoshâvareze vâ
athaurune vâ mashyâi rathaêshtâi vâ
vâstryâi vâ fshuyañte.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can those clothes,
when once washed and cleansed, ever be used either by a Zaotar,
or by a Havanan, or by an Atare-vakhsha, or by a Frabaretar, or
by an Abered, or by an Asnatar, or by a Rathwiskar, or by
a Sraosha-varez,
or by any priest, warrior, or husbandman?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那些衣物一旦洗淨潔淨，能否被查洛達爾祭司、或獻祭祭司、或火祭祭司、或執火祭祭司、或齋戒者、或頌經祭司、或馬鞭持有者、或斯勞沙侍從、或任何祭司、戰士、或農人所使用？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit tâ
vastra hãm-ýûta pasca ýaozhdâiti
frasnâiti zaothre nôit hâvanâne nôit
âtravaxshe nôit fraberethre nôit âberete
nôit âsnâthre nôit raêthwishkare
nôit sraoshâvareze nôit athaurune mashyâi
nôit rathaêshtâi nôit vâstryâi
fshuyañte.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Never can those clothes, even when
washed and cleansed, be used either by a Zaotar, or by a Havanan,
or by an Atare-vakhsha, or by a Frabaretar, or by an Abered, or
by an Asnatar, or by a Rathwiskar, or by a Sraosha-varez, or by
any priest, warrior, or husbandman.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「那些衣物，即使洗淨潔淨，也永遠不能被查洛達爾祭司、或獻祭祭司、或火祭祭司、或執火祭祭司、或齋戒者、或頌經祭司、或馬鞭持有者、或斯勞沙侍從、或任何祭司、戰士、或農人所使用。」

segments.orig:
ýat ahmi nmâne ýat mâzdayasnôish
nâirika daxshtavaiti anghat ýat vâ skeñdô
aipi-jatô pishtrô aipi- iritô gâtush aêtadha
aêtahe âste stairishca barezishca hãm-verenåñte
vîspem â ahmât ýat hãm-ci zastô
frîne nizhbarât.
segments.en:
'But if there be in a Mazdean house a woman who is in her
sickness, or a man who has become unfit for work, and who must
sit in the place of infirmity, those clothes shall serve for
their coverings and for their sheets, until they can withdraw
their hands for prayer.
segments.zh: 「但若在馬茲達教家中有一婦女正值其經期，或一男子已成為不適於勞作者，且必須坐在病患之處，那麼那些衣物應當用以覆蓋他們，用以作為床單，直到他們能伸出手來祈禱。」

segments.orig:
nôit zî ahurô mazdå ýånghuyanãm
avaretanãm paiti-ricya daithe nôit asperenô-mazô
nôit avacinô-mazô ýavat aêsha carâitika
avi mãm harekê harecayât.
segments.en:
'Ahura Mazda, indeed, does not allow us to waste anything
of value that we may have, not even so much as an Asperena's
weight of thread, not even so much as a maid lets fall in spinning.
segments.zh: 「阿胡拉‧馬茲達確實不允許我們浪費任何我們所有的貴重之物，即使只是阿斯佩雷納權重的線，即使只是婢女紡織時掉落的那麼一點點。」

segments.orig:
ýezica aête mazdayasna upairi aêtem iristem
avi mãm harekê herezyât ýavat aêsha
carâitika avi mãm harekê harecayât jvascit
nôit bvat ashava meshascit nôit baxshaiti vahishtahe
anghêush,
segments.en:
'Whosoever throws any clothing on a dead body, even so much
as a maid lets fall in spinning, is not a pious man whilst alive,
nor shall he, when dead, have a place in Paradise.
segments.zh: 「凡將任何衣物投擲於屍體之上者，即使只是婢女紡織時掉落的那麼一點點，其生時不為虔誠者，其死後亦不得在樂園中得一席之地。」

segments.orig:
tem ahûm paithyâiti ýim drvatãm
temanghaênem temascithrem temanghem tem vå ahûm
drvañtô shyaothnâish hvâish hvâ-daêna
nisirinuyât acishtâi anguhe! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'He makes himself a viaticum unto the world of the wicked,
into that world, made of darkness, the offspring
of darkness,
which is Darkness' self. To that world, to the world of Hell,
you are delivered by your own doings, by your own religion, O
sinners!'
segments.zh: 「他藉此為自己製備了往邪惡世界之糧，往那由黑暗所成、黑暗所生、黑暗本身之世界。往此世界、往地獄之世界，汝等罪人因汝等自身之作為、因汝等自身之信仰而自陷其中！」
